ownerStatement: On 23 November 2026, repeat98 approved Grain 0.1.3-experimental (“I approve 0.1.3”), chose Flex's PTCH units, and after the unit runs on package 07b6e497 said “ok let's bring this update live”, with the waivers listed here. On 27 November 2026 he re-signed it for #2240 ("ok", his answer to re-signing Grain 0.1.3 with its curve read again with room), which changes no package.
reason: Package 07b6e497b3513a7d9b1d32c278e26c0385d068e5d4a5dc2e1d96be04d916d865. 0.1.3 makes trig keys, CHROMATIC keys and MIDI notes play Grain's engine instead of plain Flex (the START flag 0x20 counts as the pool's audition only while the pool window is open on the selected track) and reads PTCH in Flex's units (60 an octave), in which stock locks CHROMATIC and MIDI notes. On the owner's MKII (OS 1.40C, development twin 95adb64b of base 0.8) five rolled-back trials showed no crash, stall, freeze or skipped track; the trig cases, the audition and the PTCH knob behaved as TESTING.md records. Nothing was heard: tuning by ear, a recorded CHROMATIC take, SCALE, a 0.1.2 project reloaded and the MKI are untested. The controls and screens are 0.1.2's, so 0.1.2's captures and tutorial stay. Worst-case chip timing and complete memory bounds remain unmeasured, as for 0.1.2. #2240 (27 November 2026) replaces evidence/frame-cost.json with the curve read again with room on a MKII: first 28.5, each 9.7 points (was 33.3 and 33.3, read at 114.4 % of a frame); the package and the descriptor price are unchanged.
